title: Still tired and puffy even though
you take your thyroid pill daily?
Foods That Block Your Thyroid Medication

items.name: Why does this happen
body: Certain foods can bind to it
before your body gets the dose

items.name: Coffee
body: Can cut absorption by up to 30%
when taken too close to your pill

items.name: Soy Milk & Tofu
body: Binds to levothyroxine in your gut
and blocks a lot of it
Even a soy latte can do it

items.name: Walnuts — the fix
body: pill and a handful of walnuts

headline: None of this means
giving these up for good
It's really just about
timing
tip: Take your pill on an empty stomach first thing,
then give it that window before anything else
